title: CB Joey Porter Jr. noncommittal when asked if he'd still play for Steelers without extension: 'I don't know'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: CB Joey Porter Jr. noncommittal when asked if he'd still play for Steelers without extension: 'I don't know'
sources.description: Porter, a 2023 second-round pick, is in line for a lucrative new contract, but Pittsburgh has made it clear it won't continue negotiations into the regular season.
